messages.subject: Paul | Global Mining Executive Profile | Country Leadership, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Templeton,

I am sharing my profile for senior global mandates across mining, natural resources, critical minerals and the energy transition.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your retained-search focus on mining and natural resources, including board, C-suite, country and regional leadership, is closely aligned with the direction of my next move. My strongest value sits where a mining business needs a senior leader who can connect operations with government, regulators, communities, investors and sustainability priorities.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership.

I have attached a mining-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority GCC markets, while I remain open to strong global mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
